f.title: Clinical trial application: include investigator safety information and patient safety measures
f.statement: An application for a clinical trial certificate shall include a copy of the information supplied to the investigators, particularly on the safe use of the medicinal product, and a protocol setting out, among other things, the nature of the records to be kept and any special measures proposed to ensure the safety of the patients.
f.clause: Reg 18(2)(e)-(f) Conditions for issuance of a clinical trial certificate

rows.quote: (e) a copy of the information supplied to the investigators, particularly in relation to the safe use of the medicinal product; and (f) a protocol of the trial setting out –
rows.location: Reg 18(2)(e)-(f) Conditions for issuance of a clinical trial certificate
rows.review_note: Review: quote covers items (e)-(f) lead-in; protocol sub-items (ii) records and (iv) safety measures follow. Double-check: OK.

f.title: Clinical trials: keep supply records and report trial progress 6-monthly and results on completion
f.statement: The importer or manufacturer distributing a medicinal product for a clinical trial shall keep complete and accurate records of all quantities supplied, keep the licensing authority informed of the progress of the trial by 6-monthly reports, and supply a copy of the results of the trial on its completion.
f.clause: Reg 18(6)(d) Conditions for distribution of clinical trial products

rows.actor: Importer or manufacturer of the trial medicinal product
rows.deadline: Progress reports every 6 months; results on completion
rows.quote: (i) keep complete and accurate records of all quantities of the medicinal product supplied under this section; and (ii) keep the licensing authority informed of the progress of the trial by 6 monthly reports; and (iii) supply to the licensing authority a copy of the results of the trial on its completion.
rows.location: Reg 18(6)(d) Conditions for distribution of clinical trial products
rows.review_note: Review: no explicit start date for the 6-monthly cycle; clock_start is the duty wording. Double-check: OK.

deadline_rule.clock_start: keep the licensing authority informed of the progress of the trial by 6 monthly reports

f.title: Report changes in data affecting safety, quality or efficacy
f.statement: A licence holder shall report to the licensing authority changes in the validity of data which may affect the safety, quality and efficacy of the licensed medicinal product.

f.title: Report serious adverse drug reactions to the licensing authority
f.statement: A licence holder shall report any serious adverse drug reactions to the licensing authority. No time frame is stated.
f.clause: Reg 20(3)(b) Standard provisions for a medicinal product licence

f.statement: A licence holder shall report to the licensing authority any batch which does not conform to the specification of the medicinal product.

f.statement: A licence holder shall recall any defective or unsafe medicinal product to which the licence relates from the market and stop its sale and distribution.
f.clause: Reg 20(4) Standard provisions for a medicinal product licence

f.statement: An import licence holder shall inform the licensing authority of any batch of the medicinal product found to be harmful or unsafe or not conforming to the product's specification.

f.statement: An import licence holder shall report to the licensing authority within 7 days from the receipt of any adverse effects or report relating to the imported medicinal product.

f.title: Include adverse effects in medicinal product leaflets
f.statement: Medicinal product information leaflets should include all necessary information on proper use, including adverse effects, overdose information, contraindications, warnings, precautions and interactions including use in pregnancy and lactation, in English, Motu or Pidgin.
